tools.description: look up a DeFi protocol, token or contract by name, symbol, slug or 0x address (Aave, Ethena, USDe, Moonwell, kUSD): Pacta's verified record with canonical slug and page URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (Base-EAS-attested vs RPC-observed only),

tools.name: who_controls
tools.description: Who can upgrade, pause or change this contract, and what is queued to change: admin, multisig signers and threshold, timelock delay, pending operations. Ethereum and Base, any address, pinned to a block.

tools.name: pacta_check_preflight
tools.description: rug check, smart contract security, who controls this contract before an agent approves, deposits into or calls it: Use for a verdict and a 0-100 score before approving, depositing or calling, or for a past block. For facts without a score use pacta_who_controls_contract. One-call pre-execution safe

tools.name: pacta_scan_wallet_exposure
tools.description: wallet risk, DeFi exposure of a wallet or Safe multisig: Use when you hold a wallet or Safe address and want its positions checked. For one contract use pacta_who_controls_contract. Read-only Multicall3 wallet & Gnosis Safe DeFi control-plane exposure scan across Ethereum and Base: Safe threshold/ow

tools.name: pacta_scan_control_plane
tools.description: who controls this contract, in full: upgradeable proxy, owner, admin, multisig, timelock: Use for the raw structure (proxy slots, Safe owners and threshold, timelock delay) or a past block. For the short answer use pacta_who_controls_contract. Live control-plane scan of an EVM contract: EIP-1967 imp

tools.name: pacta_scan_proposal_diff
tools.description: governance proposal check, what a DAO proposal changes: Re-runs the pinned contract reads of a Pacta-tracked governance proposal (Aave, Euler, Morpho, Sky) at the live block and returns pinned-vs-live diffs. Free (no key, no payment).

tools.name: pacta_verdict
tools.description: token safety, rug check, contract risk score: Same scan as pacta_check_preflight at the latest block, plus a letter grade and a one-line summary; also takes a protocol slug (with an address only, start with pacta_who_controls_contract). Fast contract / token control-plane safety verdict: verdict, ri

tools.name: pacta_dossier
tools.description: protocol due diligence, who controls this protocol, Safe multisig signers: Use for a whole protocol: every controller Safe's signers, and signers shared with other protocols. For one contract or an address only, use pacta_who_controls_contract. Machine-readable protocol control-plane dossier: live E

tools.name: trace_dependencies
tools.description: What this vault, market or token depends on: its collateral assets, who can mint them, where its price comes from and who verifies its bridge. Each link cites a contract and a block.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a position, an entry block or a rule under your wallet, tied to the contracts it depends on. Only your wallet can read it back. Up to 200 items per wallet, notes up to 500 characters; forget frees room.

tools.name: what_changed_since
tools.description: Since a block or your last check: every control, minter, price source or bridge change under your saved positions or a list of contracts, including changes that are queued and have not run yet.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Erase one saved item, or everything saved under your wallet. After the erase nothing you saved can be recalled. What remains in backups and records is in our privacy notice.

tools.name: pacta_submit_request
tools.description: request coverage or a feature (opt-in): queue a coverage or feature request with Pacta when a target is not indexed, a chain or check is unsupported, or data looks wrong (coverage_gap_hint). Ask the user first. An identical request_type + target_subject upvotes the existing request (same request_id)

tools.name: request_feature
tools.description: Tell Pacta what tool or data your agent needs; we read every request daily.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pacta_lookup_protocol, pacta_verdict, pacta_submit_request · Private data: pacta_lookup_protocol, pacta_scan_wallet_exposure, pacta_verdict, trace_dependencies, remember, forget · Public sink: pacta_submit_request · Destructive: pacta_check_preflight, pacta_scan_timelock_op, what_changed_since.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pacta_lookup_protocol, pacta_verdict, pacta_submit_request · Private data: pacta_lookup_protocol, pacta_scan_wallet_exposure, pacta_verdict, trace_dependencies, remember, forget · Public sink: pacta_submit_request · Destructive: pacta_check_preflight, pacta_scan_timelock_op, what_changed_since

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
